newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Santos port may be hit by strike on Feb 24.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Santos port may be hit by strike on Feb 24.

text.p: Warehouses workers at Brazil's key port of Santos are almost certain to go on strike on February 24 over a dispute about back pay, said an official at the Administrative Portworkers Union.

"The workers are waiting to see if there is a proposal from the port authority. Then they will have a meeting on February 23 to decide on whether to strike and how long to strike for," said Bento Marques Prazeres.
"It's about 90 percent certain that the strike will happen," he added.
Only some 140 workers would be involved in the stoppage but the strike action could bring some 70 percent of the port to a halt, Prazeres said.
Previous strikes at the port have affected shipments of commodities such as sugar, soybeans, wheat and orange juice.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
